name: Private LLM
author: hearth-team
description: Route the chat's incognito mode to a local LLM you run yourself — LM Studio, Ollama, llama.cpp's server, vLLM, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Two URL slots so you can pin a primary (e.g. localhost or LAN) plus an optional fallback (e.g. Tailscale) — Hearth tries the primary first and falls through. While incognito is active, only save-to-collateral is allowed; nothing else leaves your box.

vault_inputs.label: Primary URL
vault_inputs.help: Where your local LLM is reachable. If you omit the port, 1234 is assumed (LM Studio default — Ollama uses 11434, set explicitly). Examples: http://localhost:1234, http://192.168.1.22:1234, http://192.168.1.22 (port → 1234).

vault_inputs.label: Fallback URL (optional)
vault_inputs.help: Optional second URL — used if the primary fails. Useful for Tailscale fallback when you're away from home. Same port-default rule (1234 if omitted).

vault_inputs.label: API format
vault_inputs.help: LM Studio + most modern local servers speak OpenAI shape. Pick Ollama only if you're running ollama serve.

vault_inputs.label: Model (optional)
vault_inputs.help: Model id from /v1/models or /api/tags. Leave blank to let the server pick whatever's loaded.

vault_inputs.label: API key (optional)
vault_inputs.help: Required for OpenRouter / cloud-hosted endpoints that gate behind a token. Leave blank for LM Studio + local Ollama (neither requires one).

commands.name: private_query
commands.description: Send a single-turn prompt to the local LLM and get a reply. Use for sensitive content the founder doesn't want routed through cloud. Routes through the same engine the chat's incognito mode uses; respects the primary/fallback URL pair.

system.description: Optional system prompt prepended to the conversation
